trans-unit.source: The first period is the calendar period that contains from. With amountType netChange (the default) amounts cover that period only; with balanceAtDate they cover everything up to the period end. Projected available balance is the balance at the period end. Inventory is the on-hand quantity. A service or non-inventory item is refused. At most 53 periods and 20 items are returned.
trans-unit.target: Fyrsta tímabilið er dagatals tímabilið sem inniheldur from. Með amountType netChange (sjálfgefið) ná upphæðir aðeins yfir tímabilið; með balanceAtDate ná þær yfir allt fram að lokum tímabilsins. Áætlað tiltækt magn er staðan í lok tímabilsins.
